items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My last term there was when Red Rodney came in. I remember him coming into it.

ctx.x: Joe Wilder, of course, we were in the same class together. Red Rodney. In face, Red, when I was going to this music school, well it was a vocational school; it had a terrific music course. My last term there was when Red Rodney came in. I remember him coming into it.
And, of course, Joe Wilder was there with you.
